page_text_ocr_zh:
猫爸爸回过头对小猫说：“让老鼠的语言见鬼去吧，我再也不想在家里听到这种老鼠的语言了！”
小猫不好意思地说：“对不起，我知道了！”
以后，只有当小猫和小老鼠在一起的时候，他们才会用对方的语言交谈，他们再也不敢在家里使用了。

The cat dad turned around and said to the little cat, “Let the mouse’s language go to hell. I never want to hear this kind of mouse language at home again!”
The little cat said awkwardly, “I’m sorry, I know now!”
From then on, only when the little cat and the little mouse were together would they use each other’s language to talk. They never dared to use it at home anymore.

summary_zh: 猫爸爸因讨厌老鼠语言而发怒，小猫道歉并承诺只在与老鼠独处时才使用对方语言，从此不再在家中使用。画面中，小猫和小老鼠对视，分别发出“喵”和“吱”的声音。

page_text_ocr_zh:
森林边上，有个很大的湖泊。
湖泊边上，有棵很高的树，树上有
只很坏很坏的乌鸦。乌鸦和湖里的坏
鳄鱼勾结在一起。只要有谁来湖里游泳，她就在树上叫：

“湖里掉进一块蛋糕，
味道一定挺好……”

这是乌鸦和鳄鱼约定的暗号。
听到这叫声，坏鳄鱼就会冲出
来，袭击那个游泳者，并把他吃掉。坏
鳄鱼最后会吐出几根骨头，算是给乌
鸦的酬劳。
page_text_en:
On the edge of the forest, there is a big lake.
On the edge of the lake, there is a very tall tree, with
a very bad, very bad crow on it. The crow and the bad
crocodile are in cahoots. Whenever someone comes to swim in the lake, she calls out from the tree:

"A cake has fallen into the lake,
It must taste really good..."

This is the secret signal between the crow and the crocodile.
When they hear this call, the bad crocodile will rush out
and attack the swimmer, eating them. Finally, the bad
crocodile will spit out a few bones, as a reward for the
crow.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了森林边湖泊旁，一只坏乌鸦与湖中坏鳄鱼勾结，通过暗号‘湖里掉进一块蛋糕’来引诱并袭击游泳者，鳄鱼吃掉受害者后会吐出骨头作为给乌鸦的酬劳。

page_text_ocr_zh:
那天,有只胖胖的
小猪来到湖边,他不知道湖里有鳄鱼,脱下衣服就跳进湖里游泳了。
乌鸦在树上叫着,可是鳄鱼在湖里打瞌睡。乌鸦一连叫了几遍,鳄鱼也没动静。
这时,有只小河马经过湖
边,他瞧见小胖猪在湖里游泳,也跳下了水。可是还没等他拉开架势游泳,
小河马的爷爷老河马赶来了,河马爷爷拖起小河马说:“这里有危险!”
这里有危险!
page_text_en:
That day, a chubby little pig came to the lakeside. He didn't know there were crocodiles in the lake, so he took off his clothes and jumped in to swim.
The crow was calling from the tree, but the crocodile was dozing in the lake. The crow called several times, but the crocodile didn't move.
At that moment, a little hippo passed by the lake.
He saw the chubby pig swimming in the lake and jumped in too. But before he could even start swimming,
the little hippo's grandfather, Old Hippo, arrived. Old Hippo grabbed the little hippo and said: "There's danger here!"
There's danger here!
summary_zh: 小猪不知湖中有鳄鱼，跳入湖中游泳，乌鸦多次警告未果。小河马随后也跳入湖中，被爷爷及时拉起并警告‘这里有危险’。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小河马被爷爷赶回家了。河马爷爷没有看见湖里的小胖猪，他一回头看见了岸边的衣服，以为是小河马留下的，就抱起衣服回家了。
小胖猪游得正开心的时候，坏乌鸦又大声叫了起来：“湖里掉进一块蛋糕，不吃马上跑掉……”
鳄鱼打完瞌睡，乌鸦这一声怪叫，让他瞧见了正在游泳的小胖猪，
鳄鱼猛地游了过来。
这时，小胖猪游累了，他正想上岸，回头看见一条鳄鱼追来，连忙冲上了岸。再一看，他留在湖边的衣服不见了。
page_text_en:
The little hippo was sent home by Grandpa Hippo. Grandpa Hippo didn't see the little pig in the lake. When he turned around, he saw clothes on the shore and thought they belonged to the little hippo, so he took them home.
While the little pig was swimming happily, the bad crow shouted again: "A cake has fallen into the lake! Don't eat it, run away immediately..."
The crocodile, having just woken from a nap, heard the crow's strange cry and spotted the little pig swimming.
The crocodile suddenly swam over.
At that moment, the little pig was tired and about to get out of the water. He turned around and saw a crocodile chasing him, so he rushed to shore. Then he looked again — his clothes by the lake were gone.
summary_zh: 小胖猪在湖中游泳时，坏乌鸦发出暗号引来了鳄鱼。鳄鱼突然出现，小胖猪惊慌上岸，发现自己的衣服不见了。

page_text_ocr_zh:
惊慌失措的小胖猪逃进湖边的树林，伤心地大哭了起来。这时，有四只小青蛙闻声赶来，问小胖猪为什么哭。
小胖猪把自己在湖里游泳，差点儿被坏鳄鱼吃掉的事告诉了小青蛙。
他还说，自己放在湖边的衣服也丢了，他光着身子没法回家。

呜 呜

四只小青蛙说小胖猪胆子太大了，他们把鳄鱼和乌鸦勾结在一起害人的事告诉了小胖猪。
那只最小的青蛙还说：“自从坏鳄鱼和乌鸦来到这里，我们再也没法下湖游泳，我都快忘记怎么游泳了！”
这时，那只最大的青蛙说：“我们还是帮小胖猪想想办法，让他能回家吧！”
page_text_en:
The panicked little pig ran into the woods by the lake and cried bitterly. At that moment, four little frogs came running to ask the little pig why he was crying.
The little pig told the frogs about how he was swimming in the lake and almost got eaten by the bad crocodile.
He also said that his clothes, which he had left by the lake, were gone, and he couldn't go home naked.

Wu Wu

The four little frogs said the little pig was too brave, and they told him about how the crocodile and the crow had teamed up to harm others.
The smallest frog added, "Ever since the bad crocodile and crow came here, we haven't been able to swim in the lake. I've almost forgotten how to swim!"
At that moment, the biggest frog said, "Let's still help the little pig think of a way to get him home!"
summary_zh: 小胖猪因被鳄鱼吓到且衣服被偷而惊慌哭泣，四只小青蛙赶来安慰并告知鳄鱼与乌鸦勾结的危险，决定帮助小胖猪想办法回家。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小胖猪说他家离这儿不远，他请
四只小青蛙帮他回家拿衣服。

不一会儿，四只小青蛙赶来了，说
在小胖猪家里没找到衣服，只好把他
家床上的被单拿来了。

小胖猪这才想起，自己的衣服正
晒在屋前的树丛里，他说：“没关系，被
单也行！”就把被单披在身上了。

那只最小的青蛙，还带来了小胖
猪家一只漂亮的小篮子，他以为那是
小胖猪的帽子。小青蛙把小篮子扣在

了小胖猪的头上。

小胖猪走回家去，四只小青蛙紧
跟在他后面，提着长被单的两只角，
不让它们拖在泥地上。
page_text_en:
The little fat pig said his home wasn't far away, so he asked
four little frogs to help him go home and get his clothes.

Soon after, the four little frogs arrived and said
they couldn't find the clothes in the little fat pig's house, so they took his
bedsheet from the bed.

The little fat pig then remembered that his clothes were
hanging in the bushes in front of his house. He said, "It's okay, the
sheet will do!" and put the sheet over his shoulders.

The smallest frog also brought a pretty little basket from the little fat pig's home. He thought it was
the little fat pig's hat. The little frog put the basket on

the little fat pig's head.

The little fat pig walked home, and the four little frogs followed
right behind him, holding the two ends of the long sheet,
so it wouldn't drag on the muddy ground.
summary_zh: 小胖猪被鳄鱼吓到后，四只小青蛙赶来帮忙，帮他拿回衣服并用被单裹住身体，还把小篮子当帽子戴在头上，随后一起回家，小青蛙们提着被单防止拖在泥地上。

page_text_ocr_zh:
！！
正在这时，一个山妖来到湖边钓鱼。他看见在湖边走着的小胖猪，以为自己碰见了一位国王，一位这里的湖泊之王——
这位“湖泊之王”戴着漂亮的王冠，披着很威风的大斗篷，身后还有四位侍从紧跟着。
山妖非常惊奇，他十分恭敬地说：
“尊敬的湖泊之王，非常荣幸见到您，如果您有什么吩咐，我乐意照着去办！”
page_text_en:
!!
At this moment, a mountain demon came to the lakeside to fish. He saw the little fat pig walking by the lake and thought he had met a king, the king of this lake—
This "King of the Lake" wore a beautiful crown, draped in a very imposing large cloak, with four attendants following closely behind.
The mountain demon was very surprised. He spoke with great respect:
"Respected King of the Lake, it is a great honor to meet you. If you have any requests, I am happy to carry them out!"
summary_zh: 山妖来到湖边钓鱼，误将小胖猪当作湖泊之王，对其恭敬行礼并表示愿意效劳。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小胖猪扶了扶头上的“王冠”，压低嗓门说：“祝你交好运，我会让你钓到好东西的。”
小胖猪抬头望着树上继续说：“山妖啊，请用这树上的乌鸦当钓饵，你就会大有所获。请带着你从湖里钓到的好东西，回你的山洞慢慢享用吧！”
“是，我乐于遵命！”
山妖纵身一跳，就逮到了树上的坏乌鸦，他把坏乌鸦放在鱼钩上当钓饵，抛进了大湖里。
page_text_en:
The little fat pig adjusted the 'crown' on his head and whispered, 'Wishing you good luck, I'll help you catch something good.'
He looked up at the tree and continued, 'Mountain demon, use this crow on the tree as bait, and you'll gain greatly. Please take the good things you catch from the lake back to your cave and enjoy them slowly!'
'Yes, I'm happy to obey!'
The mountain demon leaped and caught the bad crow on the tree. He placed the bad crow on the fishing hook as bait and cast it into the big lake.
summary_zh: 小胖猪伪装成湖泊之王，命令山妖用坏乌鸦作钓饵钓鱼，山妖遵命将坏乌鸦抛入湖中。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，四只小青蛙一起压低嗓门，学着乌鸦的声音叫了起来：“湖里掉进一块蛋糕，味道一定很好……”
刚才让小胖猪跑了，坏鳄鱼正在懊恼呢。他一听到歌声就猛地窜了出来，咬住了山妖的钓饵，于是，他的长嘴巴一下子让鱼钩钩住了。
山妖使劲把鳄鱼拽上了岸，他对小胖猪说：“谢谢湖泊之王的指点，这条皮厚厚的怪鱼，够我吃上好一阵子了！”
山妖拖着水淋淋的鳄鱼走远了。
page_text_en:
At this moment, four little frogs lowered their voices and imitated the crow's call: "A cake fell into the lake, it must taste wonderful..."
Just now, the bad crocodile had let the little fat pig escape. He was feeling annoyed. As soon as he heard the song, he suddenly lunged out, bit the mountain demon's bait, and thus, his long mouth got hooked.
The mountain demon pulled the crocodile onto the shore and said to the little fat pig, "Thank you, King of the Lake, for your advice. This thick-skinned monster fish is enough for me to eat for a long time!"
The mountain demon dragged the wet crocodile away.
summary_zh: 四只小青蛙模仿乌鸦的暗号引诱鳄鱼上钩，山妖成功将鳄鱼钓上岸并拖走，小胖猪则作为‘湖泊之王’被山妖感谢。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，河马爷爷抱着小胖猪的衣服又来到湖边，他的身后跟着小河马。
河马爷爷说：“小胖猪，对不起！
刚才我抱走了你的衣服，你可不能在这儿游泳啊……”
“放心游吧！坏鳄鱼和坏乌鸦完蛋了！”四只小青蛙把刚才发生的事告诉了河马爷爷，大家可高兴了。

扑通、扑通、扑通……

四只小青蛙、小胖猪和小河马接连跳进湖里，湖面激起一阵又一阵的水花……
page_text_en:
At this moment, Grandpa Hippo, carrying Little Fat Pig's clothes, came back to the lakeside, with Little Hippo following behind.
Grandpa Hippo said, "Little Fat Pig, I'm sorry! I just took your clothes, you mustn't swim here..."
"Swim safely! The bad crocodile and the bad crow are finished!" The four little frogs told Grandpa Hippo what had just happened, and everyone was very happy.

Plop, plop, plop...

The four little frogs, Little Fat Pig, and Little Hippo jumped into the lake one after another, splashing waves again and again...
summary_zh: 河马爷爷带着小胖猪的衣服来到湖边并道歉，四只小青蛙告知坏鳄鱼和坏乌鸦已被制服，大家高兴地跳入湖中游泳，湖面溅起阵阵水花。

page_text_ocr_zh:
河马爷爷呢，坐在湖边帮他们
看衣服。他看着六个小伙伴在湖里
快活地扑腾着，觉得比自己下湖还高兴……

冬天摄影师
page_text_en:
Where is Grandpa Hippo? He's sitting by the lake, helping them
watch their clothes. He watches the six little friends splashing happily in the lake, feeling even more joyful than when he himself goes swimming...

Winter Photographer
summary_zh: 河马爷爷坐在湖边帮大家看衣服，看着六个小伙伴在湖里快乐地游泳，感到非常高兴。右侧页面标题为“冬天摄影师”。
